name: Turkey Burger Salad with Spinach, Mango, Avocado & Spicy Lime Aioli

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 ½ red bell peppers
3 mangoes
1 ½ avocados
3 (142 g) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Place turkey, bread crumbs, eggs, and spices in a large bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ground turkey
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 eggs
1 ½ tsp basil, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, zest and juice limes into a small bowl. Add mayo and spices, then whisk to combine the aioli. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp cayenne pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, until golden underneath, about 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-6 minutes, until cooked through. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Place on another clean plate.
Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; thinly slice the flesh. Add to the plate with the bell pepper.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate.
To serve, divide spinach between plates or bowls. Top with bell pepper, mango, avocado, and burger patties. Drizzle with aioli and enjoy!
